fish.name: Candlewick Sprat
fish.flavor: A finger-length fish with a flame-shaped glow on its tail that gutters when it's nervous. It is always nervous.

fish.name: Sooty Grumbler
fish.flavor: Complains in long strings of bubbles about the cold, the dark, and the neighbors. The neighbors are also Sooty Grumblers.

fish.name: Inkwell Guppy
fish.flavor: Leaks a fine black ink wherever it goes, as if forever signing something important. Scholars keep them in jars, just in case.

fish.name: Pillowfin Blob
fish.flavor: Soft, round, and profoundly unbothered. Holding one is said to cure insomnia, homesickness, and most Tuesdays.

fish.name: Milkeye Darter
fish.flavor: Its pale eyes see nothing, which down here is exactly the right amount. Startles at loud thoughts.

fish.name: Thimble Skate
fish.flavor: Small enough to perch on a thumb, which it will do, given the chance. Grannies of the trench are said to sew with them.

fish.name: Hushfin Minnow
fish.flavor: Presses a fin to its lips whenever anything makes a sound. Nobody knows what it's listening for, and it won't say.

fish.name: Wick Eel
fish.flavor: Glows faintly along its spine like a candle burned nearly to the end. Refuses to be relit; says it's pacing itself.

fish.name: Doorknob Chub
fish.flavor: Round, brassy, and oddly formal. Turn it gently and something, somewhere, unlocks. Best not to think about it.

fish.name: Static Sardine
fish.flavor: Crackles softly, like a radio between stations. On quiet nights, whole shoals of them pick up the weather report from somewhere that doesn't exist.

fish.name: Penny Loach
fish.flavor: Carries exact change in its cheeks at all times. For what, it has never explained, but it seems prepared.

fish.name: Cellar Smelt
fish.flavor: Smells like an old basement in a comforting way: cool stone, forgotten jam, one sturdy spider. Keeps well.

fish.name: Marrowlight Angler
fish.flavor: Its lure glows the exact color of a lit window seen from a cold road. Many things swim toward it, wanting very much to be home.

fish.name: Fiddlebone Gar
fish.flavor: Its long skull is strung like an instrument, and in strong currents it plays itself. The tunes are old, and everyone almost remembers them.

fish.name: Weeping Dab
fish.flavor: Cries constantly, though down here the ocean politely absorbs the evidence. Ask it what's wrong and it cheers right up; it just likes the routine.

fish.name: Knucklebone Sculpin
fish.flavor: Rattles like a cup of dice when it swims. Trench folklore says if you hear one roll a seven, make a wish; if you hear it roll a one, apologize.

fish.name: Hexed Herring
fish.flavor: There are always exactly thirteen in a school, no matter how many you catch. The herring find this funnier than you do.

fish.name: Chandelier Drifter
fish.flavor: Hangs in the dark trailing lit tendrils, like a ballroom fixture that wandered off mid-waltz. Deeply offended by dust.

fish.name: Backwards Barb
fish.flavor: Swims tail-first and insists it is the rest of the ocean that's going the wrong way. So far, no one has proven it wrong.

fish.name: Mothgill Monk
fish.flavor: Drifts on wide, dusty wings toward any light it finds, murmuring what might be prayers or might be gossip. Leaves a faint powder on the line.

fish.name: The Polite Gulper
fish.flavor: Swallows things considerably larger than itself, then looks mortified about it. Always says grace, occasionally mid-bite.

fish.name: Grandmother's Needle
fish.flavor: Trench-folk say it slips through the dark mending torn nets, one perfect stitch at a time. They also say that if you've been rude to your elders, it unpicks them instead.

fish.name: Porcelain Ghoul
fish.flavor: Glazed white and hollow, it chimes gently when it turns, like teacups remembering a party. Handle with the good towel.

fish.name: Vicar of Vents
fish.flavor: Delivers long, earnest sermons to congregations of tube worms, who cannot leave and therefore count as devoted. Its beard is immaculate.

fish.name: Lullaby Eel
fish.flavor: Hums cradle songs older than any harbor, and sailors who hear them sleep wonderfully. They dream of teeth, but wonderfully.

fish.name: The Ferryman's Toll
fish.flavor: Every scale is a coin from a drowned pocket, and it knows the story behind each one. Pay it a compliment and it may carry you somewhere you were owed.

fish.name: Choir of One
fish.flavor: It sings in flawless six-part harmony, alone. Count the voices and you get a different number each time; the fish has stopped counting and simply enjoys the acoustics.

fish.name: The Ninth Bell
fish.flavor: Shaped like a cathedral bell that grew tired of its tower and swam. It rings once a decade, and for that one long note, everything in the trench stops to listen.

fish.name: The Unlit Lantern
fish.flavor: An angler whose lure sheds darkness instead of light, a small held-out helping of midnight. Whatever it hunts by darkness has never been catalogued, and it dangles the bait toward you like an offer.

fish.name: The First Dark
fish.flavor: Older than the rumor of the sun, it wears faint ribbons of light the way you might keep letters from someone long gone. The trench is not a place; it is the room this creature left behind when it turned over in its sleep.
